compiled_state.title: [e2e_field_validation_probe.sh/run_reconciler]: LAST_RECONCILER_LOG uses mktemp -t -> divergent macOS/GNU semantics (rule:mktemp-tmp violation)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/e2e_field_validation_probe.sh:122 (run_reconciler) uses:
  LAST_RECONCILER_LOG=$(mktemp -t recon-probe.XXXXXX.log)

The -t flag has divergent semantics on macOS (BSD) vs GNU mktemp and is prohibited by CLAUDE.md rule:mktemp-tmp (always:mktemp-tmp). 

## Fix
Replace with a template form: mktemp "/tmp/recon-probe.XXXXXX.log" (production/orchestrator script context — no per-test TMPDIR isolation contract). Discovered during the dcf3 live-investigation reading of the probe.
